requirements.name: Stream handshake
requirements.requirement: Capture and deliver only on rising-edge valid/ready handshakes. Hold the complete offered output record stable while stalled.

requirements.name: Independent ingress capture
requirements.requirement: Keep a registered two-beat capture FIFO per input. Captured entries become serviceable on the following edge. One input can fill or stall independently of the others.

requirements.name: Metadata
requirements.requirement: Take metadata from the first accepted beat. Preserve the specified egress metadata across the frame. Reused opaque tags do not alias frame identity.

requirements.name: Legal frame size
requirements.requirement: Accept declared lengths 60 through 1536 bytes in primary and 60 through 192 bytes in small. Reject out-of-range lengths.

requirements.name: Byte order and final keep
requirements.requirement: Send bytes in ascending lane order. Require contiguous low-bit keep on final beats and all lanes on nonfinal beats.

requirements.name: Cell count
requirements.requirement: Reserve the ceiling of declared bytes divided by 64. Cover one-cell, exact cell boundary, partial final cell and maximum geometry cases.

requirements.name: Whole-frame reservation
requirements.requirement: An accepted reservation consumes the full cell credit and one descriptor atomically.

requirements.name: Old-state admission
requirements.requirement: Evaluate rotated eligible capture heads in order against earlier grants in the prefix. Return IDs and credits become eligible on the following edge.

requirements.name: Static queue limits
requirements.requirement: Test existing queue credit plus the proposed reservation against the configured static limit and both shared pools.

requirements.name: Dynamic queue limits
requirements.requirement: Protect configured minima. Assess borrowed credit against the post-reservation shared capacity with widened arithmetic and the specified alpha rounding.

requirements.name: Reject reason
requirements.requirement: Apply public rejection precedence when several constraints fail. A failed request consumes no reservation.

requirements.name: DROP and WAIT
requirements.requirement: Drain when DROP rejects. Under WAIT, keep temporarily blocked heads pending and reject invalid or permanently impossible heads.

requirements.name: Admission rotation
requirements.requirement: Advance from the first serviced decision in the batch. Retain the cursor on an empty batch.

requirements.name: Cell ownership
requirements.requirement: Pick one pre-edge-free physical cell per write; accept each legal distinct normal or cleanup return once.

requirements.name: Descriptor ownership
requirements.requirement: Select distinct old-free IDs across up to four primary or two small grants. Merge each distinct return once.

requirements.name: Payload ports
requirements.requirement: Support one 512-bit read and one write per edge. Ownership excludes same-address read/write.

requirements.name: Fixed read latency
requirements.requirement: Return mandatory tagged responses after one or two cycles. Reserve buffer credit at issue and consume the response at the published edge.

requirements.name: Links
requirements.requirement: Append a link on allocated write. Capture the next link at issue except on the last cell. Reuse IDs after legal return.

requirements.name: Credit conservation
requirements.requirement: Track physically free, unreserved, reserved-free, assigned and queue-owned credit. Enforce exact merged deltas for reservations, writes, TX returns, abort reclamation and cleanup.

requirements.name: Read credit
requirements.requirement: Each egress has six slots including outstanding responses and the cell being serialized. Use pre-edge slot credit.

requirements.name: Publication
requirements.requirement: Publish on the edge after a validated final cell write. The published frame becomes selectable on the following edge.

requirements.name: Queue ordering
requirements.requirement: Serve each queue in publication order and preserve transmit binding order between classes on an egress.

requirements.name: Concurrent queue update
requirements.requirement: Merge concurrent append and pop. Preserve the correct head and tail on singleton replacement, and use the old successor when the queue is longer.

requirements.name: Active queues
requirements.requirement: Make the active bitmap match merged next-state queue occupancy.

requirements.name: Packet round robin
requirements.requirement: Use the specified rotating round-robin policy to select among eligible class heads in packet RR mode.

requirements.name: Byte DRR
requirements.requirement: Track deficit and visits in bytes. Reset empty queues as specified. Debit the bound frame exactly once.

requirements.name: Strict priority
requirements.requirement: Select the eligible strict-priority class before DRR peers in strict-plus-DRR mode. Once bound, preserve successor order through stalls.

requirements.name: Rate shaping
requirements.requirement: Check pre-edge queue and port token balances, charge once at binding and apply refill in the specified order.

requirements.name: Successor binding
requirements.requirement: Open the successor window at the specified active-frame remainder. A tentative choice has no dispatch, debit or read effects.

requirements.name: Egress isolation
requirements.requirement: Track binding, serialization and credits per egress so a stalled output cannot occupy another output's slots.

requirements.name: First beat
requirements.requirement: Check framing before assembly. A valid header with malformed first beat may reserve and abort on one edge with no cell write.

requirements.name: Malformed suffix
requirements.requirement: Abort a malformed frame while retaining any permitted staged write from before the abort mark. Discard unwritten staging of that frame.

requirements.name: Drain boundary
requirements.requirement: Drain the malformed or rejected frame under the published resynchronization rules. Accept a new frame only when the applicable drain and cleanup conditions are met.

requirements.name: Disposition
requirements.requirement: Produce the specified terminal disposition per frame in ingress order, including committed, rejection and format-error outcomes.

requirements.name: Acceptance-based retirement
requirements.requirement: Return TX cells on accepted cell-final beats and descriptors on accepted frame-final beats.

requirements.name: Abort cleanup
requirements.requirement: Use the dedicated cleanup lane. Reclaim physical cells without releasing queue credit early. Release remaining credit and the descriptor once at completion.

requirements.name: Logical reset
requirements.requirement: Gate transfers during reset. Flush live ownership and initialize pools and control before enabling packet traffic.

requirements.name: Epoch isolation
requirements.requirement: Prevent old responses, outputs, dispositions and returns from changing new-epoch state after reset.

requirements.name: AXI4-Lite protocol
requirements.requirement: Accept AW and W independently and hold responses stable under backpressure.

requirements.name: Register map
requirements.requirement: Use the public register map, address decoding, access restrictions, strobes and error responses.

requirements.name: Configuration lifecycle
requirements.requirement: Apply policy writes only in allowed states and validate merged fields against their bounds.

requirements.name: Counter updates
requirements.requirement: Merge simultaneous port and queue events without losing increments. Expose the specified occupancy and statistics.

requirements.name: Snapshot
requirements.requirement: Sample the defined pre-edge live state into coherent split-word snapshots.

requirements.name: ECN
requirements.requirement: Mark ECT frames at the configured threshold from pre-publication queue credit and preserve the specified handling of other codepoints.

requirements.name: Supported configurations
requirements.requirement: Qualify primary and small, each with read latency one and two. Reject incompatible profile parameters.

requirements.name: Balanced throughput
requirements.requirement: For the specified four-port ready-sink fixed permutations, deliver and accept one beat per port per cycle in the measurement window and reconcile all offered frames after drain.

requirements.name: Mixed traffic
requirements.requirement: Measure mixed destinations, independent frame lengths, incast, stall behavior and shaping as separate workloads.

requirements.name: Mapped timing
requirements.requirement: Measure the implemented small and primary configurations at explicit library, clock, IO and reset conditions and document any SRAM assumptions.
